name: Minerva
tagline: Open source, goal/milestone-first project management for schools and non-profits.
description: Open source, goal/milestone-first project management for schools and non-profits: teams start from what they are trying to achieve, break it into milestones, and track progress against those. SvelteKit frontend, Rust (Actix-web) backend, PostgreSQL. The interface is a status board: cool neutral ground, ink rules, four signal colours, tabular mono figures — the term's health readable at a glance.

logo.notes: Fraunces wordmark with a terracotta dot over the i — the only colour in the wordmark. Clear space: 1/2 the height of the lowercase n (about 31% of the logo height) on every side, scaling with the logo. Minimum size: wordmark 96 px screen / 25 mm print; symbol (M.) 32 px or 16 px with the favicon file / 8 mm print. One-colour black, white and ink versions for fax, stamps and single-colour print. Never retype, stretch, squash, rotate, outline or add effects; approved logo backgrounds are ground (#F2F3F4), white, ink (reversed) and terracotta (all white).

colors.name: Ground
colors.usage: page canvas; cool neutral, not warm

colors.name: Ink
colors.usage: body text, headings, rules; dark surfaces; the Complete status square (settled reads neutral-final)

colors.name: Slate
colors.usage: secondary text, column heads and metadata

colors.name: Ink line
colors.usage: rules and dividers — 1 px; ink at 12% on light, paper at 14% on dark

colors.name: Ink block
colors.usage: primary actions: a solid ink block with a paper label (inverts to a paper block with an ink label in dark mode)

colors.name: Terracotta
colors.usage: the wordmark's dot only — brand commitment, unchanged by the board world

colors.name: On Track
colors.usage: status square and tint; status always renders as a solid square beside an ink label, never coloured text

colors.name: Error text
colors.usage: semantic error copy; the Off Track hue, lifted toward paper in dark mode (55% red / 45% foreground) so small text clears 4.5:1 — status squares keep the pure hue

colors.name: Complete
colors.usage: set in ink itself — settled reads neutral-final; the world has no blue. In dark mode it is paper

colors.name: Alert amber
colors.usage: reserved for rows a person set by hand (manual status overrides) — the alert hold; never for decoration

colors.name: Ink rail
colors.usage: the sidebar and mobile top bar: #101114 with paper text (#f2f3f4, muted #a7a9ae) in light mode; #0c0d0f in dark mode so it stays darker than the page

display.notes: No serif display: headings are the workhorse sans at weight 600 with -0.01em tracking. The Fraunces wordmark is official artwork (SVG), and its collapsed 'M.' text symbol stays set in Fraunces to match it.

figures.notes: Self-hosted via @fontsource/spline-sans-mono; tabular-nums. Carries every count, date and stamp — the board's figures. Never used as a costume for prose.

voice.tone: A well-run staff room: warm, capable and unfussy. Plain, direct sentences about getting the term's work done — no enterprise overhead, no corporate jargon.
messagingPillars: Open source project management for schools and non-profits — self-hosted, without the enterprise overhead.
Goal/milestone-first: teams start from what they are trying to achieve, break it into milestones, and track progress against those — rather than managing a flat list of tasks.
Keeps staff, volunteers and boards on the same page.

avoid: flat task-list framing — Minerva is goal-first, not a to-do app

imagery.style: Cool and institutional: a neutral grey canvas, white panels, ink rules, four status signal colours and one reserved alert amber
imagery.treatment: Real photography on the neutral ground or white panels with 1 px ink-tinted borders; status hues are reserved for status, alert amber for manual overrides only; no gradients, glass or effects on brand marks
avoid: shadows, gradients or effects on the logo
recoloured dots or letters outside the palette
the colour logo on photos or busy backgrounds without a solid container

layout.spacing: 4px base grid; 1200px content column; 56-80px section rhythm; body 16px/1.65
postureRules: Component kit should cover: Button, Card, Form, Navigation.
Neutral ground (#F2F3F4), white panels, 1 px ink-tinted borders (12% ink on light; 14% paper on dark).
The navigation is an ink rail in both modes: sidebar on desktop, top bar plus tab bar below 900px — the page's light/dark state is a property of the content, never of the navigation.

Status always renders as a solid colour square beside an ink small-caps label — On Track #1F7A4D, At Risk #D99A1B, Off Track #CE2D2D, Complete in ink. Alert amber #FFB020 is reserved for manually-set rows (the alert hold).
Every count, date and stamp is set in Spline Sans Mono with tabular figures; headings are the system sans at weight 600.
Primary actions are solid ink blocks with paper labels (paper blocks with ink labels in dark mode).
Dark mode: near-black ground (#131417 canvas, #1B1D21 panels, #F2F3F4 text) with a darker rail (#0C0D0F); the primary action inverts to paper.
